Climate: High humidity, abundant rainfall and steady temperatures
Crime Rate: Low (homicide rates have declined significantly in the past decade)
Work Life Balance: Varies by employer and industry, urban centers tend to have a faster pace
Main Cities: Georgetown, Penang, Malacca, Kota Kinabalu, Ipoh
Main Industries: Electronics Manufacturing, Automotive Manufacturing, Service Sector, Oil and Gas, Palm Oil Production
Largest Companies: Maybank, Tenaga Nasional, Tenaga Del, PBBank (Public Bank Bhd), IHH Healthcare
Interesting Fact: The Strait of Malacca has been the site of many treasure shipwrecks.
Work Permit: Relatively easy to obtain, especially in key sectors (e.g., tech, education, manufacturing).
Top Universities: Universiti Malaya, Universiti Kebangsaan Malaysia, Universiti Putra Malaysia, Universiti Teknologi Malaysia and Universiti Sains Malaysia.
Cultural Values: Respect for elders, family, and community, as well as a strong sense of culture.
People description: Malaysian people are typically known for their friendly and welcoming nature, reflecting the diverse multi-ethnic society where different cultures seamlessly blend together.

Climate: Temperate with four seasons, moderate rainfall
Work Life Balance: Strong separation between work and private life, 35–40 hours/week typical
Largest Companies: Volkswagen, Siemens, BMW, BASF, Deutsche Bank
Interesting Fact: Home to the world's oldest brewery, Weihenstephan (since 1040)
Citizenship Process: Usually 8 years for non-EU nationals, with integration
Work Permit: Relatively easy for high-skilled workers and EU citizens
Top Universities: LMU Munich, Heidelberg, TU Munich, Humboldt University
Cultural Values: Punctuality, efficiency, environmental consciousness, social solidarity
People description: Germans are described as organized, efficient, and respectful of rules, friendly in private.

Climate: Humid subtropical, typhoons in summer, snowy winters in the north
Work Life Balance: Work hours are long but reforms are improving balance
Interesting Fact: Japan has more vending machines per capita than any other country
Top Universities: University of Tokyo, Kyoto University, Osaka University, Tohoku University, Nagoya University
Cultural Values: Politeness, respect for hierarchy, harmony, diligence
People description: Japanese people are known for politeness, group harmony, and dedication.

Climate: Mild, with warm summers, cool winters
Work Life Balance: 35-hour workweek, high value on leisure and family
Largest Companies: L'Oréal, TotalEnergies, BNP Paribas, Airbus, Danone
Interesting Fact: France has the most time zones of any country (12)
Work Permit: Point-based for non-EU, easier for EU
Top Universities: Sorbonne, Sciences Po, Polytechnique, HEC Paris
Cultural Values: Liberté, égalité, fraternité, culinary culture, intellectual debate
People description: French people are proud of their culture, direct, and very sociable.

Climate: Cold winters, warm summers, varied by region
Main Industries: Natural Resources, Technology, Finance, Aerospace, Agriculture
Largest Companies: Royal Bank of Canada, TD Bank, Enbridge, Shopify, Bombardier
Interesting Fact: Canada has more lakes than the rest of the world combined
Top Universities: University of Toronto, McGill, UBC, University of Alberta, University of Waterloo
People description: Canadians are known for being polite, welcoming, and valuing diversity.

Climate: Tropical and subtropical, rainy summers, dry winters
Work Life Balance: Long hours in some sectors, informal work common
Main Cities: São Paulo, Rio de Janeiro, Salvador, Fortaleza, Recife
Main Industries: Agriculture, Mining, Energy, Finance, Services, Tourism
Largest Companies: Petrobras, Vale, Itaú Unibanco, Bradesco, Ambev
Interesting Fact: Brazil is home to the largest Japanese community outside Japan
Work Permit: Easier in some sectors, more complex otherwise
People description: Brazilians are known for friendliness, creativity, and social energy.

Climate: Varies by region: arid, temperate, tropical north
Crime Rate: Very low (safe, petty crime in some cities)
Work Life Balance: Flexible work options, outdoor lifestyle valued
Largest Companies: Commonwealth Bank, BHP, Westpac, ANZ, CSL
Interesting Fact: Australia has more kangaroos than humans
Citizenship Process: 4 years with permanent residency, test and integration
Top Universities: University of Melbourne, University of Sydney, ANU, UNSW, UQ
People description: Australians are friendly, direct, and value humor and equality.

Climate: Tropical rainforest, high humidity, no distinct seasons
Work Life Balance: High pressure but efficient, flexible hours in tech and finance
Main Industries: Finance, Shipping, Biotech, IT, Tourism, Manufacturing
Interesting Fact: Singapore is the only city-state with its own tropical rainforest reserve
Citizenship Process: 2–7 years based on contributions and integration
People description: Singaporeans are cosmopolitan, pragmatic, and highly disciplined.

Climate: Diverse: temperate, continental, desert, subtropical, tropical in Hawaii and Florida
Work Life Balance: Long hours common, remote and flexible work increasing
Main Cities: New York, Los Angeles, Chicago, Houston, Miami
Largest Companies: Apple, Microsoft, Amazon, JPMorgan Chase, ExxonMobil
Interesting Fact: The US is the only country to have landed humans on the moon
Work Permit: H-1B system for skilled, other categories exist
People description: Americans are known for optimism, openness, and ambition.

Climate: Arid desert, hot summers, mild winters
Work Life Balance: Work hours tend to be long, weekends are Friday-Saturday
Main Cities: Dubai, Sharjah, Al Ain, Ajman, Ras Al Khaimah
Main Industries: Oil and Gas, Real Estate, Tourism, Logistics, Finance
Largest Companies: Emirates, Etisalat, DP World, Emaar, First Abu Dhabi Bank
Personal Income Tax: 0–30% (progressive scale, no income tax for many expats)
Interesting Fact: About 90 percent of UAE's population are expatriates
Citizenship Process: 30 years for naturalization, rare for non-GCC nationals
Work Permit: Work permit process is straightforward for most professionals
Top Universities: Khalifa University, UAEU, American University of Sharjah, Zayed University
Cultural Values: Respect, hospitality, business focus, tradition and modernity
People description: People in the UAE are cosmopolitan, ambitious, and welcoming but keep a strong link to tradition.

Crime Rate: High (petty crime and some violent crime in urban areas)
Work Life Balance: Work hours are long in some sectors, informal economy significant
Main Cities: Johannesburg, Cape Town, Durban, Pretoria, Port Elizabeth
Largest Companies: Sasol, Shoprite, Naspers, FirstRand, Standard Bank
Interesting Fact: South Africa is the only country with three capitals
Citizenship Process: 5 years residency, but difficult for non-Africans
Work Permit: Difficult except for critical skills list jobs
Top Universities: University of Cape Town, Wits, Stellenbosch, Pretoria
People description: South Africans are diverse, resilient, and community-oriented, proud of their cultural heritage.
